exclusions.source_text: Patients must be \>= 12 months and =\< 21 years of age at the time of study enrollment
Patients must have a performance status corresponding to Easter Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) scores of 0, 1 or 2.
Creatinine clearance or radioisotope glomerular filtration rate (GFR) \>= 70 mL/min/1.73 m\^2 or a creatinine based on age/sex as follows
Bilirubin (sum of conjugated + unconjugated or total) =\< 1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN) for age
Serum glutamate pyruvate transaminase (SGPT) (alanine aminotransferase \[ALT\]) =\< 135 U/L.
Ejection fraction of \>= 50% by gated radionuclide study
Pregnant or breast-feeding women will not be entered on this study
CYP1A2 (e.g., ciprofloxacin, enoxacin, fluvoxamine, smoking) are not eligible
Part A: Patients with relapsed or refractory solid tumors or lymphoma, including patients with CNS tumors or known CNS metastases (including untreated or progressive) are eligible
